title: Three-dimensional organ segmentation and structural phenotyping of salt-stressed coriander seedlings using the optimized point transformer-based model PTV-SegCo.
summary: A point-transformer model segmented coriander seedling organs in 3D and derived structural phenotypes under salt stress. The study compared measurements with manual references; this is a specific plant-phenotyping result, not evidence of field yield or agronomic benefit.

evidence.tested: Three-dimensional organ segmentation and derived phenotypes were evaluated against manual measurements in salt-stressed seedlings.
evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the tested coriander seedlings and manual comparisons; crop yield and field performance were not established.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
